caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular woven textile pattern that features a series of vertical stripes, each formed by rows of small, evenly spaced horizontal segments. The stripes vary in width and are composed of different color combinations including shades of tan, olive green, dark green, pink, red, mustard yellow, black, brown, beige, and light gray. The segments within each stripe are stacked uniformly from the top to the bottom edge of the rectangle. The pattern occupies the central part of an off-white or creamy background, with the textile's edges distinct against this backdrop. The drawing is signed "Arthur E. Mackley" in the lower right corner outside the textile area.
title: Stair Carpet
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
